We are here
to help.

Quick answers about adventures, location and augmented reality. Questions? Contact netanelvision@gmail.com.

Location is not updating

Make sure Location Services are enabled and TreasureTales can access your location while you use the app.

The AR character does not appear

Allow camera access, move to a well-lit area and slowly move your device so it can detect a surface.

Safety during an adventure

Stay aware of traffic, obstacles and your surroundings. Never use the app while driving, and children should play with adult supervision.

Deleting your account

Open Profile → Settings → Delete account in the app and confirm. See the privacy policy for what is deleted.

Need more help?

Email netanelvision@gmail.com and we will be happy to help.
